SELECT weekStartDate, campus, total, donorCount, newDonorCount, recurringDonorCount, source
FROM giving_weekly
WHERE weekStartDate IN ('2026-03-22', '2026-03-23', '2026-03-29')
ORDER BY weekStartDate, campus;
